'''Kaius''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who joined the [[Eternal Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] around [[3631 BBY]]. Kaius became embroiled in an argument with the [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] [[Leta]], who said that [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]]&mdash;the former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]&mdash;was testing the Sith and that everything that had happened was part of [[Gender/Legends|his]] ultimate vision for [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for the state of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Kaius, on the other hand, blamed the former Emperor for both the Eternal Empire and the Sith Empire's current state.
